sentences.en: May deep sleep engulf you, so that you rest from insomnia!
sentences.zh: 愿你沉入深深的睡眠，远离失眠!

sentences.en: Laurel leaf tea is said to fight insomnia.
sentences.zh: 据说喝 Laurel 叶茶能对抗失眠。

sentences.en: Grumpy suffered from insomnia, that's why he was always in a bad mood.
sentences.zh: Grumpy 因为失眠总是心情不好。
